en.topic_title: China says it opposes new US tariffs, warns against trade wars

zh.topic_title: China says it opposes new US tariffs, warns against trade wars

en.topic_title: China says it opposes new US tariffs, warns against trade wars
en.topic_summary:
Beijing condemned fresh US tariffs imposed on China and 59 other countries over alleged forced labour concerns Friday, and warned Washington against waging a trade war.



A container terminal in Hong Kong. File photo: GovHK. 



The US levies range from 10 to 12.5 percent, with China slapped with the highest rate.



“We oppose all forms of unilateral tariff measures,” Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Lin Jian told a news briefing on Friday.
